name: Honest inspection + Exfiltration polish
summary: Patch release from live use. Inspection no longer overstates or hides: 'ENCRYPTED (TLS)' requires real evidence (SNI/handshake/TLS-port), and captured wire bytes are always shown — readable text as text, cleartext-binary as a hexdump — instead of a false 'metadata only'. Plus the Exfiltration tree now scrolls, the views say 'Exfiltration' (not 'Egress'), and the README is reorganized with real screenshots.
updateSource: live-use feedback on the exfil inspector + views

required.title: Evidence-based TLS verdict + always show the wire bytes
required.summary: A throttled cleartext :80 download was branded 'ENCRYPTED (TLS)' because its binary body looked like ciphertext. 'Encrypted (TLS)' now requires positive evidence — a ClientHello SNI, a TLS record header (looksTLS), or a well-known TLS port (mark.PortEnc). And captured bytes are always surfaced: readable text as text (HTTP headers show), cleartext-binary as a hexdump (ASCII gutter surfaces embedded text), TLS ciphertext left unshown (noise). Revises the §6 'never render encrypted' rule, which over-hid.
evidence: go test ./internal/inspect/ . ./internal/tui/ (new: cleartext-binary-as-hex, TLS-ciphertext-not-dumped, hexdump gutter, port-aware TLS)
live: :80 download reads CLEARTEXT · binary with a hexdump

required.title: Exfiltration tree viewport scroll
required.summary: The tree had no viewport — expanding an app past the bottom edge clipped the overflow with no way to reach it. Added the same stateless-clamp viewport the Findings pane uses, keeping the selected row on-screen.

required.title: Exfiltration labels + README overhaul
required.summary: The views said 'Egress'; aligned the user-facing labels to Exfiltration / exfil (internal egress package/types unchanged). Reorganized the README around a real-screenshot gallery + a prominent sudo/TCC callout, with the explanatory prose moved to the bottom; dropped the synthetic screenshot generator.

deferred.title: Destination NAMES (SNI/DNS) in the tree, not just IPs
deferred.summary: Show the destination hostname (SNI) instead of IP:port in the Exfiltration tree/zoom. The inspect engine already parses the ClientHello SNI; thread it (or a cached DNS-query correlation) into the observe loop.
deferred.reason: Scope: reverse-DNS is what nettop -n disables for speed (the 5s stall), so the good version is passive SNI capture / DNS correlation — a real feature, not a config flip. Next up.
